items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: George was with Ted Lewis about 16 years and I was with him about seven... all the records that you were on, George would be on then, too

ctx.x: Anything else you can tell while we're thinking about George? Have you seen him lately? I haven't...
I haven't seen George in two, three years. He's working in Chicago. Yeah, I know he's still up there.
